data.name: Nasuh
data.gender_notes: Nasuh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'anasa' which means to give sustenance or support. In Islamic context, Nasuh refers to someone who is righteous, obedient to Allah, and provides support to others. The name Nasuh carries the meaning “Righteous, obedient” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nasuh usually hope their child will grow to embody righteous, obedient and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Be a righteous supporter in the path of Allah.
data.etymology: Nasuh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Righteous, obedient.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nasuh total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nasuh is a commendable mantle of honor and respect for those who bear it. The name Nasuh carries a distinct aura of respectability and nobility in Islamic societies.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Nasuh stands as a reminder to live a virtuous and obedient life. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) emphasized the importance of being righteous, stating that, "Parsonance is half of faith." (Sahih Muslim - 46/6124). The name Nasuh serves as a constant reminder to offer support and sustenance to others, keeping in mind the Prophetic Hadith, "It is not for you to be pleased with them, but Allah is Pleased with them and they will be admitted to Paradise." (Bukhari - 6/60/881).
